descriptor: Photographer collective and vertical story archive

voice.summary: Speaks in tight, tactile captions: where, when and on what film. It treats each panel like a single beat in a night shoot and keeps comment short enough to read between swipes.
dos: Caption with place, time and gear in one line
Use vivid verbs and sparse adjectives
donts: Do not describe the obvious in the image

taglines: Shot at dusk, shared at speed
One frame at a time, all night
boilerplate: Night Reel is a photographer collective that publishes an archive of dusk and night stories as full-screen vertical panels, each with a short note on where and how it was shot.
